batting.name: PA Patel
batting.dismissal: c L Ronchi b A Nehra

batting.name: SK Raina
batting.dismissal: c DJ Bravo b MA Khote

batting.name: MS Dhoni
batting.dismissal: c DJ Bravo b MA Khote

batting.name: ST Jayasuriya
batting.dismissal: c Joginder Sharma b MS Gony

batting.name: DJ Bravo
batting.dismissal: c JDP Oram b Joginder Sharma

batting.name: MA Khote
batting.dismissal: c SK Raina b M Muralitharan

batting.name: Harbhajan Singh
batting.dismissal: c S Badrinath b M Muralitharan

balls.text: Badrinath fails to dispatch a low full and only manages to push it towards midwicket for a single

excellent catch! The slower ball and Dhoni goes the loft over midwicket, he gets a top edge and that was in the air for ever, Bravo runs across towards mid-on and falls over backwards as he takes the catch
good comeback, Oram digs out a yorker back to the bowler, they set off for a suicidal run, Khote had all the time in the world for the direct hit and Oram had infact given up, Khote misses by a mile
Khote lets that one slip out and it's a low full toss for Oram who creams that past extra cover off the sweetspot, he's off the mark
drifts on the pads, he goes for the whip across the line a little too early and the ball deflects off his pads to the on side
Into the second tier! Can we have the ball back please? Khote bowls that full and Dhoni lofts that high over the bowler's head, that went back 80m, we understand

swipes that across the line to Harbhajan at midwicket and takes off, Hayden is a little slow off the blocks and is miles out of his crease as harbhajan gets it spot on with the direct hit. Ironically, Hayden is dismissed by his nemesis!
pitches on a length, he waits on it and flat bats it past the bowler, that's the 50 stand in just 24 balls
class! Nehra pitches that outside leg and Dhoni shows scant respect by sweeping him to fine leg
tries a yorker but bowls a low full toss, he pushes it towards Pollock at long-on almost on one hand
fullish outside off, he punches it through the line to long-off
over the waist, Hayden tries to slide that over point but gets an edge which flies past the keeper and slip
good ball, the slower ball outside off, Hayden walks across the stumps to paddle that but fails to pick the slower ball
well bowled, Dhoni steps down and decides against the stroke as he sees the ball pitching outside off, he glances at the umpire thinking it would be called a wide
fullish on the pads, he whips this one to deep square leg
Hayden walks down a few paces down the track before he delivers and nonchalantly scoops this through the line to the long-off fence, one bounce and four
Kulkarni bowls a low  full toss and Hayden steps down and flicks this wide of short fine leg
he tries to scoop this over the bowler's head but mistimes it to long-off
I tell you that wasn't really a poor ball, Kulkarni lands it on a full length outside off but Dhoni uses all his power and biffs that across the line past deep midwicket, all power
he creams a full delivery past the bowler but the ball crashes onto the stumps at the non-striker's end, the ball rolls to the on side and they pick up a run anyway
this pitches on a length on middle, Dhoni gets back and punches it past midwicket and calls for the second run very quickly
another low full toss outside off, he scoops that high over the region of mid-off
pitches it short, he gets in position early for the pull and places it to deep square leg
low full toss outside off, he crashes that towards long-off
full and wide outside off, Hayden biffs that through the line to long-off and nearly takes Dhoni's head, phew!
Hayden plays a reverse paddle and places it to short third man
Goodness gracious! Hayden walks across his stumps early, sees a meaty full toss on the stumps and mercilessly paddles that past short fine-leg, this guy's good!
sees his charging down the track and pitches it on a good length, Dhoni taps that hards towards Harbhajan at cover and sets off
Bravo misdirects a low full toss on his pads and Dhoni just whips that past short fine-leg
he dishes out his trademark slower ball and Dhoni is deceived as he tries to cut square on the offside
Dhoni gives him the charge, he adjusts on seeing the shorter length and cuts that crisply past backward point, super timing
Bravo slides down the legside and Dhoni shapes to flick it fine, he misses
the bowling change works, he pitches it full outside off, Raina lofts across the line but only manages to hit it down Bravo's throat at long-on
aims for the yorker outside off, he digs it out back to the bowler
fullish on the pads, he taps it towards long-on, the running is excellent and raina really puts pressure on the fielder there
Hayden takes the ball on the full outside leg and plays another reverse paddle, howvever some excellent fielding at short third man cuts off a boundary
another low full toss outside off, he swings across the line and places it to deep square leg
low full toss outside off, he chips it on the up towards long-on, Raina brings up his 50, the 100-run stand is up
he reaches his fifty with a bang! Nayar pitches it short again, he stays at the crease and bangs that over long-on
the slower ball, lands on a fullish length outside off and he pushes through the line to long-off
>b>Dropped: Raina lobs it on the full back to Nayar and he fumbles, juggles and misses it
fetch that! Nayar bowls that short of a length from around the wicket and Raina just biffs that high over deep midwicket
the slower ball, Hayden waits on it and pulls to deep midwicket

Great Snakes! How did that miss? Hayden goes for the pull but plays too early, he gets a thin underedge and Ronchi claims the catch, there was a bit of confusion out there but the umpire gives Hayden the benefit of doubt
fuller delivery down leg side, flicked to leg side
driven to mid-on
slower ball, Hayden plans to reverse-sweep but checks himself and is waiting horizontal-bat and all when the ball comes to him. He taps behind square, sweep-style, to wide third man
driven to long-off
pitched outside leg stump, played and missed
full toss on leg stump, flicked to midwicket
low full toss, flicked across the line to deep midwicket
flicked to deep midwicket
bizzarre delivery, way outside the leg stump, Raina wants to have a go but seems to miss the ball after it pitches and it slips past his bat for four
full toss, pulled to midwicket
flicked to deep midwicket, where Robin Uthappa makes a valiant effort to get the ball away from the boundary rope by Nayar, when collecting it, pushes it over
pitched on off stump, Hayden gets it to balloon right next to him but the keeper can't get to it
fuller, pitched on leg, Hayden gets behind the line of the ball and flicks to Harbhajan at midwicket
Hayden charges out to a low full toss and plays across the line. He gets an under-edge and the ball rolls away to fine leg
slower ball, pushed to cover
a mistimed pull to midwicket
pushed to long-off
shorter ball, Raina pulls without turning his whole body. He mistimes but still manages to go over the midwicket boundary
another low full-toss, but Raina just pushed it to long-off
driven powerfully down to long-off where it was intercepted with great agility by Bravo
drags it from outside off but gets an under-edge to midwicket
full toss, Raina stayed at the crease and lifted the ball, with ease, into the stands at long-off
pitched outside leg, quicker, and Hayden rapped on pads
pitched on off and turned away, hayden backed away but didn't play a shot
tries to loft it over long-off but mistimes and is fielded by Yeligati extra cover
pulled to deep backward square leg
rolled his fingers over the ball but Hayden takes it on full toss and hitd to long-off for four
short of length, tried to pull but hit on the pads
short of length, pitched on middle, Raina drives it to covers
over the wicket and pitched outside off stump, Raina slashes at it but misses
fuller and on middle, Hayden digs it out to mid-off
pitched on middle and driven to mid-on
Raina uses his feet and flicks to leg side
Raina slashes to backward point
pitched outside yet again, Raina dances out of the crease and gives himself room to pull to deep midwicket. He's lucky it falls between two fielders
pitches outside leg stump, Raina turns it behind square
drives straight  down to fielder at long-off
Raina gets an edge while pulling and takes a quick single
pulled to midwicket
short ball, Raina gets his bat in periscope length but manages to pull it away just in time
fuller and towards off stump, Hayden drives to wide long-off
slightly short of length, on leg stump again, Raina gets a quick single
good length, on leg stump,  pushed to point
the slower ball again, he shapes to slash it through the offside and misses
good delivery, cramps him for width outside off but Raina opens the face and deftly glides it down to third man
poor delivery by Nehra who slides that really wide down leg, that was out of the hitting zone too
good comeback, fires in the inswinging yorker but Hayden manages to dig it out to the on side
the slower ball again, nearly deceives hayden who makes a bit of room and mis-hits that over backward point
Nehra bangs that one short of a length outside off and Hayden mercilessly biffs that wide of midwicket, the ball really travelled at breakneck speed
Nehra sees Hayden giving the charge and bowls a slower ball but he strays down the legside
lands just outside off and comes back in, he pushes it through the line towards midwicket
slides on his pads, he whips it wide of midwicket
pitches slightly short and climbs on him as he taps it down towards cover, he calls for a run but Hayden says no
what a wicket for Mumbai! Kulkarni holds the length back outside off, Hussey gives him the charge but fails to read the length early as he gets a thick under edge and removes his offstump
Hussey decides enough is enough as he charges down the track, sees the width outside off and scoops this over extra cover
slightly fuller outside off, Hussey cuts that straight to Bravo at backward point
bowls over the wicket, lands it on off and middle and Hussey pushes that towards cover
Hussey gets a bit of width and taps it towards cover and calls quickly for the run, there's a slight fumble in the field, good over by Nehra
good stuff by Nehra, gets it to nip back in and keeps Hussey quiet as he taps it back to the bowler
lands on a good length outside off, he opens the face of the bat and taps it to backward point
tempts him with width outside off but Hussey watchfully lets it go
lands on a length outside off, he opens the face and steers it to backward point
edged! Nehra gives him width outside off, Patel goes for the ezpansive drive and gets a very thin edge through to Ronchi
beaten! Hayden attempts a pull but plays too early, he misses it, the ball beats the top of middle stump and beats the keeper
low full toss outside off, Hayden biffs that through the line and the ball travels in a flash to the long-off boundary
wide outside off, Hayden makes room but decides not to chase that
the first of the match, Pollock dishes out a slower one, Hayden lofts through the line and carts it over long-on, the ball crashes on the Madras Cricket Club roof
good innovation, Pollock pitches it on a length outside leg, hayden moves across and paddles it over Nehra at short fine-leg
swing and a miss, Hayden tries to pull and meets thin air, the ball nearly shaves the offstump too
overpitched on middle and off, it was in the slot for the drive and Patel creams it past mid-on
pushed to mid-on, a misfield by Yeligati doesn't cost a run
slashed! Patel gets a lot of width outside off and reaches out, the ball gets the thick edge and just beats slip who leaps up to try and get that
slices him in half this time as Patel tries to whip it across the line

almost a run-out! Nehra bowls this one quicker, Hayden gets a thin edge onto his boot and sets off as the ball rolls towards cover, Patel sets off, Hayden is slow off the blocks and the throw was just wide of the stumps at the non-striker's end
lands on a fullish length just outside off, Hayden opens the face of the bat and slices it softly towards point
just fractionally short outside off, Patel gets his bottom hand working and pulls along the ground past midwicket, slightly mistimed
first false stroke, he sees the width marginally outside off and slashes and misses
and they're underway in style, Pollock overpitches outside off, Patel turns his wrists and flicks it wide of mid-on, super timing
turns his wrists this time and flicks it from outside off towards mid-on
he taps it towards cover and contemplates a single but a good piece of work at short cover saves a run
pitches on a good length, he gets some wood behind it and taps it towards point
not such a good start, that pitches outside off and seams away sharply, good bounce too
Joginder doesn't overstep, Nayar scoops this down to long-off
Oh my goodness, a dot ball! Nayar makes room and digs out a yorker straight to cover
dishes out another yorker and Nehra manages to dig it out towards cover for a single
Nehra swings and misses, he tries his best to make contact with that yorker outside off
he oversteps! Nayar makes room and square drives this to Badrinath at backward point
that's four more! Joginder errs by dishing out a half volley outside off, he makes room, gets on his knee and carves it over extra cover
Joginder bangs it in short, Nayar backs away outside leg and pulls that with intent over midwicket, the ball just falls short of the rope
Nayar improvises with a reverse sweep but fails to beat short third-man
Murali finally has his say here! Harbhajan stays at the crease and tries to go downtown, he gets a thick top edge and Badrinath runs across and hangs onto the skier at long-on
shot boss! The captain's leading by example here as he takes a few paces down and caresses a full delivery outside off to deep point
gives it flight and cuts back on the pace, nayar steps down the track and checks his stroke as he tucks it softly towards Joginder at deep square leg
steps down the track and picks it on the full to long-on

slides down leg, he steps down the track and flicks it on the full to fine leg, Harbhajan scampers back for the second run and Joginder's throw to Dhoni is a second late as he gathers the ball and breaks the stumps, third umpire has a look
he swings across the line and clubs this one hard, Gony takes it on the first bounce at long-on
the slower ball, Harbhajan swings too early and misses
wow! Pitches on a fullish length outside off and Harbhajan stays there and clubs that high into the second tier at long-off, it's game on here!
Harbhajan connects this time and sends a full delivery outside off high over long-on, that was clubbed 77 m past the rope
another yorker, this was further away from offstump, Harbhajan tries to dig it out but misses
Oram begins well as he dishes out a yorker and Harbhajan misses as he tries to paddle that
and there's more! Nayar gets an overpitched delivery outside off and clobbers that high over long-off, the timing was excellent
the over gets worse for Amarnath as he bangs this one short and Nayar pulls this one past midwicket
good improvisation by Nayar as he gets on his knee and paddles that from outside off and places it to the vacant deep square-leg boundary
good yorker, he digs it onto his boot and sets off for a run as the ball rolls past the stumps
in the slot to biff outside the offstump and Harbhajan obliges by making room and clubbing it over long-off
Amarnath slides down leg and the ball clips his boot before reaching Dhoni
low full toss, he gets across and turns it on the full to midwicket
makes room and cuts it down hard on the turf to short third man
misfield! Nayar sweeps hard and the ball nearly cleans up umpire Harper at square leg, Amarnath runs across from fine leg and overruns the ball
Khote chances his arm again and goes for another slog sweep, this time he fails to get the desired elevation and finds Raina at long-on who's just a few inches in front of the rope
massive! Khote stays at the crease and executes a slog sweep and deposits that ball over deep square-leg
pitches it wide outside off, he makes room and cuts to short third man, can't find that gap there
well bowled, Joginder pitches it on a good length and cramps him for room as he backs away and tries to force it through the offside, he taps it back to the bowler
the slower ball, he makes room and cuts that to deep cover
Dropped: It was a tough one, Khote clubs a low full toss wide of Joginder and he gets a finger to it, long-off picks it up
pitches it short outside off and Khote cuts away from his body, Amarnath tumbles at third man and intercepts it

Oram pulls off a blinder! Bravo makes room and scoops a full delivery down to long-off, the ball really travels in a flash and Oram runs across and cups it with both hands and dives. It was excellent judgment, given the speed at which it traveled
good ball, he bowls the slower one and Bravo is beaten as he tries to dig it out past Dhoni
stays at the crease and chips that high over midwicket, Hayden runs back and tries to pull off a stunner but the ball beats him
shot! Full outside off and he just creams that through the line past the diving long-off fielder
pitches it short, he stays at the crease and pulls that really high over square leg
comes round the wicket this time, he places it to backward point and Badrinath has a shy at the stumps, the ball hits the sweet spot of Bravo's bat and races away to third man for four over throws
lovely shot, Nayar makes room for himself and picks a full delivery outside off and carves it over cover
Amarnath tempts him with width outside off and Nayar completely misses it as he tries to swing across the line
charges down the track and whips it on the full down to Gony at deep midwicket
takes the aerial route and the ball just falls short of Oram at long-off
drives a full delivery very firmly and Murali does well to intercept it with his foot
he gets on his knee and bravely drags that from outside off and places it to deep square leg
pitches outside off and gets it to straighten, he rocks back and punches it to long-on
slides wide down the leg side
going going! flighted on middle and leg, Bravo stays at the crease and sends that back at least a dozen rows over long-on
Bravo plays a typical Caribbean flick on one leg and sends that high over square leg, Gony runs across and just manages to cut it off
pitches short of a length on middle, he taps in front of cover and sets off

Pollock makes room again but Amarnath this time pitches it much shorter, he goes for the pull and the ball comes on quicker, he edges onto his pads and the ball deflects and pegs the middle stump back
take that! Amarnath overpitches outside off and Pollock makes room and scoops that over extra cover, that travelled like lightning
walks across his stumps and flicks it wide of square leg
good ball, pitches outside off and comes back in, he gets back and defends
well bowled, flights it outside off and keeps him quiet as he settles for the forward defense
the straighter one, he gets across and whips this down to long-on
gets well forward and smothers the turn
flighted outside off, he pushes through the line to the offside
appeal, he goes for the sweep and the ball appears to clip his pad first before rolling to the on side
finally, he manages to land it within the stumps this time and Pollock defends
that's a hat-trick! Murali struggles to grip the ball again and slides wide down leg
action replay, he slides that wide down leg again
starts off rather inauspiciously by sliding wide down leg
the slower ball, he waits for it and taps it softly towards cover and sets off
fullish outside off, he pushes that to long-off
timber! Joginder bowls that full and straight on legstump, Uthappa makes room and swing across the line and misses, the leg stump goes for a tumble and goes back by a few yards
low full toss, Uthappa makes room and scoops that with brute force over the covers
fullish outside off, he pushes this to long-off
goes for another wild swing and he misses
pitches it short and Uthappa swings and really clubs it hard over midwicket, the ball travels like lightning before reaching the boundary on the first bounce
Uthappa charges down the track and Amarnath cleverly digs it in short, he swings and misses
good ball, comes back in and Pollock steers it to the offside
pitches outside off and comes back in, he opens the blade and dabs it down to third man
full on middle and leg, he drives to long-on
edgy but safe, Gony pitches it up outside off, Uthappa plays it with soft hands and glides that wide of the keeper down to the third man boundary
full outside off, he pushes that firmly through the line to Joginder at long-off
great stuff again by Gony as he fires in a yorker, he digs it out back to the bowler
hits a good length outside off, he leans forward and drives towards deep cover
that one slips out and lobs over Pollock's waist, he scoops that over midwicket
Pollock makes a bit of room to cut but he ends up chopping it down towards Dhoni, he has a shy at the stumps
steps down and pulls that from outside off and places it to Patel at deep square leg
pitches on middle and leg, he closes the face and tucks it to midwicket
slightly wide outside off, he opens the blade and glides it down to third man
slides on the pads, he whips it towards midwicket
fuller in length outside off, he digs it out to mid-off
starts off with a short one and Pollock pulls it to the fielder at deep backward square leg
shapes to cut but ends up chopping it down towards cover, a misfield allows a single
aims for the yorker and he digs it out towards cover, good stuff by Gony
Uthappa drags that from outside off and tries to club that through the on side but mistimes it wide of mid-on
pitches on middle and leg, he tucks it to the on side
Gony wins another battle as Uthappa attempts another cheeky glide, the extra bounce squares him up and beats him
Uthappa goes for a wild swing across the line and meets thin air, Gony beats him for pace
holds the length back and gets it to jag back in, he hops and tucks it to the on side
very delicate, Oram gives him width and Uthappa opens the face of the bat and deftly glides it past Hussey at wide first slip
shot boss! And that's the 100th six of the tournament,  Oram overpitches on the pads and Uthappa merely lofts through the line and just clears the long-on rope
slammed! Oram overpitches outside off and Uthappa slams that on the up and carts that high over mid-off
full outside off, he drives to mid-off
well played, Uthappa sees the width outside off and deliberately steers it between slip and the keeper with very soft hands, first slip is really wide
slides down the legside and he flicks it off his gloves down to fine leg
raps him high on the pads again and Gony appeals for a legbefore
Jayasuriya tries to go downtown but fails to get on top of the bounce, he only manages a top edge and Joginder takes the skier easily at mid-on
pitches on off and middle and Jayasuriya improvises well by flicking that across the line and chipping it over square leg
good stuff by Gony, pitches on off and cramps him for room, he taps it back to the bowler
Uthappa gets across, turns the face of the bat and places it wide of square leg
pitches outside off, he gets to the pitch and drives to cover
Jayasuriya gets across his stumps and executes a pull off one leg over midwicket, appeared like a top edge but the ball was well clear of any fielder
fullish outside off, he errs by giving him width and Jayasuriya creams that through extra cover
Oram bangs that short of a length and Jayasuriya picks the length early and pulls that over square leg
opens the face of the bat and plays a controlled glide down to third man
pitches outside off, he pushes it towards cover and sets off quickly
that's a maiden, impressive by Gony as he hits the deck hard and gets the ball to kick on Uthappa, he hops and fends it to the on side
fullish outside off, he slices it on the front foot and an alert Badrinath at backward point cuts it off
pitches it short of a length outside off, he hops and steers it towards point
hits the deck hard, cramps him for room and he only manages to defend
gets this one to nip back in sharply and catches him high on the pad, the appeal is more confident now
Gony slides that on the pads and Uthappa flicks it down to fine leg, there's a stifled appeal by Gony as he reckoned the ball hit the pad in front of the stumps

excellent bit of fielding! Jayasuriya taps it in front of cover point, the calling is very circumspect but Ronchi sets off anyway, Jayasuriya sends him back, Badrinath collects it and hurls it at Ronchi's end and hits the stumps, the third umpire has a look
cuts back in after pitching, Ronchi this time hops and tucks this in front of mid-on and sets off
Jayasuriya hops and taps it in front of mid-off and sets off quickly
Oram loses his line again and slides that wide down the legside
short and wide outside off and Jayasuriya cuts that high over backward point
wide outside off and slightly short, he opens the blade and uppercuts it to third man
slides wide down the legside, Oram loses his line
Oram pitches this on off and gets it to kick on Ronchi, he taps it to the offside
